Caption: Digboi me thand ne dastak de di hai, aur humne ketli chadha di hai. Is season ki pehli kadak Masala Chai — adrak, elaichi aur bagaan wali patti ke saath. Subah ki pehli chai yahin se shuru karo.

Caption: 1901 se Digboi duniya ko tel de raha hai. Ab waqt hai Digboi ko uski apni chai-adda pehchan mile. Digboi Tea House — jahan is nagri ki history aur Assam ki chai ek hi cup me milti hai. Aao, baitho, ek cup ho jaye.
